messages:
sara_chen: Heads-up — after the workspace-permissions rollout we saw a cross-org read against acct `customer-42`'s project. Not a full breach but metadata and some device IDs returned. Anyone else seeing this?
raj_patel: saw the alert too. Triggered by a scheduled scan from staging -> prod workspace mapping? digging into the sync job now.
sec-bot: alert: /alerts/2024/06/scan-5487 - access_check:granted scope=project id=proj-ct-42 principal=svc-sync@staging -> resource=projects/proj-ct-42/keys (kms_access=false)
devon_wong: sharing the policy diff that landed in the rollout:```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "project.viewer", "members": ["group:staging-sync"]},
    {"role": "kms.viewer", "members": ["group:staging-sync"]}
  ]
}```
devon_wong: note — the new merge routine flattened `workspace_id` into `project_scope` and dropped org_id checks when matching cross-workspace grants.
lisa_morgan: that sounds like the bug. we intended the merge to enforce `org_id == resource.org` but the comparator used `workspace_id` only.
sara_chen: can we confirm the blast radius? which customers/projects hit?
raj_patel: preliminary logs show 3 projects affected over a 12-minute window. I have a grep command: `grep "access_check:granted" /var/logs/auth/2024-06-05.log | grep proj-` — will post exact list in a sec.
sec-bot: linked evidence: https://redwood.internal/logs/scan-5487 (access requires SSO)
devon_wong: short-term rollback option: revert merge to previous comparator and redeploy. long-term: add unit+integration test that asserts `binding.scope.org_id == resource.org_id`.
lisa_morgan: mitigation plan: 1) rollback policy merge (raj), 2) rotate affected service account keys (security), 3) add audit alert for cross-org grants (devon), 4) run full audit of KMS decrypt/grant logs (sara).
sara_chen: agree. Raj — can you cut the PR to revert? tag me when ready.
raj_patel: on it. PR: https://github.com/redwood/perm-sync/pull/712 - draft revert, running CI.
sara_chen: security follow-ups: 1) revoke active tokens for svc-sync group 2) schedule KMS key access review with cust-owner 3) send customer notification if we confirm any plaintext exposure.
lisa_morgan: for KMS — logs show no decrypts from external principals, just key list/read. still need to rotate keys if any service accounts had decrypt permissions.
devon_wong: adding integration test now, will push to `perm-sync` pipeline. snippet:```go
func TestMergeEnforcesOrg(t *testing.T) {
  // simulate binding merge across two workspaces from different orgs
}
```
sara_chen: good. I'll open an incidents ticket and start drafting comms. @lisa_morgan can you own customer outreach if we need it?
lisa_morgan: yep, I can take comms. will prep a short template.
raj_patel: revert PR merged, rolling back to canary. will post deploy status in 5m.
sec-bot: deploy:perm-sync canary -> success (ver=2.3.1)
raj_patel: canary looks clean. access logs show no further cross-org grants after 1735000280.
sara_chen: thanks. action items and owners: rollback (raj), audit & tokens (sara), ksm/key review (lisa), tests/alerts (devon).
devon_wong: will add an alert rule: "cross_org_binding_grant > 0" -> pager.
sec-bot: incident created: INC-20240605-23.
sara_chen: closing the thread after incident summary. please add any leftover notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
